annotations.title: TIA — disconnect device from IO system

description: Removes the interface of an IO device from its IO system (to leave the subnet use tia_network_disconnect). `interface` is the interface item name from tia_device_network (default: the primary network interface). Refused, nothing changed: 409 not_io_device, 404 not_found. The result carries `ioSystem:null`, `changes` and a `postcheck` (the serve re-reads the assignment after the write); a mismatch is 409 postcheck_failed (details.mismatches): re-read with tia_device_network. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve (needs an open project): it runs the same guards and returns the plan WITHOUT changing anything. Maps to POST /iosystems/disconnect. M-off.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

interface.description: IO device interface item name, as listed by tia_device_network (default: the primary network interface)
